whenToUse: Form fields that commit one value from a nested tree, such as a category, region, file or department
Picking several nodes at once, such as permissions, report columns or shipping zones with cascading checks
Deep or large hierarchies as Miller columns, an expanding tree, an inline panel or levels fetched on demand

whenNotToUse.when: A short flat list of options with no nesting
A folder hierarchy browsed on the page rather than picked into a form field
A table of records whose cells are edited in place and saved together

agentNotes: Parts live in separate files with no index: `CascaderItems` comes from `cascader-item`, while `CascaderInput` and `CascaderValue` come from `cascader-nav`
Give every node a `value` that is unique across the whole tree, not only within its level; a repeated `value` silently drops the later row
